articles.title: AMD Deepens AI Push With France Deal And Wayve Auto Bet
articles.mainIdea: AMD Deepens AI Push With France Deal And Wayve Auto Bet
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: AMD Deepens AI Push With France Deal And Wayve Auto Bet. AMD (NasdaqGS:AMD) announced a multi year collaboration with the French government to support France’s national AI strategy, focused on sovereign and data center level AI infrastructure. The company also committed a US$60 million investment in UK self driving startup Wayve, alongside Arm and Qualcomm, targeting next generation automotive AI systems.
